newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended lower across the board on Friday, as a weaker Chicago market overnight triggered active selling here, traders said.
Prices were 230 to 350 yen lower. The benchmark November 1997 contract ended down 230 yen at 14,060 yen a tonne.
Price falls at the CBOT corn market overnight discouraged local investors and triggered active selling from the opening, the traders said.
Investors carried out light technical buying in the early afternoon, but the market mood remained bearish throughout the day, the traders said. Volume was 86,742 lots.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.77-1/4 per bushel at 0835 GMT, against $2.78 at Thursday's close.
The spot November CBOT soybean futures contract was at $6.94 at 0835 GMT, down from $6.96-1/2 at Thursday's close.
